summary: 18 units reviewed: 14 fix, 4 ok. 1 error (unit 16 Hindi adds 'भी' twice as emphasis), 25 minor. Word splits, cases, roots and compound types are sound throughout; token coverage matches the e-text. The recurring problem is bracketed glosses inside the Hindi (units 1-8, 10-13, 15, 16, 18) and small interpretive additions in English ('rightly', 'of robbers', 'i.e. the ideal enemy', 'of the soldiers', 'the king's'); patches supply bracket-free Hindi for each. Glossary now fixes prakṛti, sampat, the seven constituents, ātmavān and naya. Needs a person: unit 6 'bhrukuṭī.kṣaṇaḥ' (the e-text's dot convention implies bhrukuṭī + kṣaṇa; the draft reads īkṣaṇa) and the word śakla, whose meaning is unsettled; also the 'samyama' text flag (may be the e-text's own spelling, not a typo). No regrouping suggested.
